sql: SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', NULL, 3.0::DOUBLE, true), (2, 'a', 'u', 4.0, false), (3, 'b', 'v', 5.0, true), (4, NULL, 'v', 6.0, true), (5, 'b', 'u', 7.0, false), (6, 'b', 'v', 8.0, false)) t(id, g, k, c, p) DECIDE x(INT) SUCH THAT x >= 0 AND sum(x) <= 10 AND x <> 3 MAXIMIZE sum(x) ORDER BY id
